sloka: आकर्णात्स विकृष्याथ तद्धनुर्धन्विनां वरः ।तं मुमोच महाबाणं लवणस्य महोरसि ।। ७.६९.३४ ॥
transliteration: ākarṇātsa vikṛṣyātha taddhanurdhanvināṁ varaḥ ।taṁ mumoca mahābāṇaṁ lavaṇasya mahorasi ।। 7.69.34 ॥

translations.english: Then, the best among archers, Shatrughna, having drawn that bow up to his ear, released that great arrow onto Lavana's broad chest.
